svg.title: Modern provincial achievement — 2022 mandate letter
svg.desc: The December 7, 2022 mandate-letter source shows a modern colored supported achievement. The exact user-uploaded modern BC full-arms vector is preserved in its original colour and uniformly fitted. The tiny printed source does not resolve every fine line of the uploaded reference. The adjacent BRITISH COLUMBIA wordmark belongs to the publication layout and is outside this armorial occurrence.
